capabilities.explanation: Exact algebraic-number resources are planned as a separately attested browser artifact with bounded handles, degrees, transfers, and precision. This capability is included in the receipt-authenticated production WebAssembly artifact.

Batched complex gamma values share the bounded analytic Arb core and become available only with an authenticated browser artifact. This capability is included in the receipt-authenticated production WebAssembly artifact.

Batched Dirichlet L-values have a shared Arb core and exact decimal transport; the production browser artifact must still attest the module. This capability is included in the receipt-authenticated production WebAssembly artifact.

Quadratic Dedekind zeta batches use the shared Riemann-zeta and Dirichlet-L core and remain unavailable until the browser artifact attests it. This capability is included in the receipt-authenticated production WebAssembly artifact.

Standard Riemann xi values use the shared bounded analytic core and become available only with an authenticated browser artifact. This capability is included in the receipt-authenticated production WebAssembly artifact.

Batched Riemann zeta values use exact decimal ball transport and a shared Arb core; the production browser artifact must still attest it. This capability is included in the receipt-authenticated production WebAssembly artifact.
Elliptic-curve coefficients use exact point counting and Euler recurrences in browsers when desktop curve accelerators are absent.
Integral elliptic-curve coefficients use the pinned ffpoly 1.2.7 and smalljac 4.1.3 algorithms inside the production WebAssembly reactor, with the exact portable recurrence retained as a fallback.

Elliptic L-series plots use bounded 10,000-point tiles and a plot-only binary64 transport once the production curve module is attested. This capability is included in the receipt-authenticated production WebAssembly artifact.

Elliptic L-series batches use decimal-ball transport in a bounded moderate domain once the production curve module is attested. This capability is included in the receipt-authenticated production WebAssembly artifact.
Semistable elliptic curves compute root numbers from certified local data in browsers without requiring a desktop addon.
